create_MLP_model: create a Multi layer perceptron model with configurable num_cells, layer_class, and activation_class for multi-agent reinforcement learning
build_MlpConfig: build an MlpConfig dataclass to configure MLP models with num_cells, activation_class, norm_class, and num_feature_dims settings
test_Mlp_forward: test the Mlp forward pass that flattens input features and routes through MultiAgentMLP or individual MLP networks
review_Mlp_checks: review the Mlp _perform_checks method that validates input shapes, agent dimensions, and output spec consistency
refactor_Mlp_multiagent: refactor the Mlp class to support centralized and parameter-shared multi-agent input with MultiAgentMLP from torchrl
